Frontend E2E via preview URL could not be executed reliably: Expo dev server (port 3001) repeatedly crashes with V8 'JavaScript heap out of memory' during Metro bundling (max-old-space-size=2048MB), causing Cloudflare 502/504 on /login and other SPA routes. integration_issues.issue: Expo dev server (:3001) crashes with V8 heap OOM during Metro bundling of index.js/expo-router render.js (~2632/2668 modules); Cloudflare edge returns 502/504 when requests hit the preview URL. Retry loop over 6+ minutes never yielded a successful bundle before another OOM restart cycle. serve-production.js falls back to Expo dev server because /app/frontend/dist/client has no SPA HTML routes exported.

Investigate Expo dev-server memory ceiling (2048MB) vs bundle size (>2600 modules). Options: (a) raise --max-old-space-size in /etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf 'expo' program; (b) ensure yarn export:web writes full SPA fallback HTML into /app/frontend/dist/client so serve-production.js does not need Metro. Currently only special HTML files (offline.html, qr.html, ms-login.html, iframe-*.html, v7-preview.html) are in dist/client — no index.html/login.html/dashboard.html.
Consider forcing full-page fallback in serve-production.js (dist-fallback appears to only fire briefly) so that even without Expo, SPA loads client-rendered bundle.

rca of the issue: Expo dev-server (started via `yarn expo start --port 3001 --non-interactive`) needs to bundle ~2632 Web modules + 2668 SSR modules on every cold start. Configured heap of 2048MB is insufficient — Metro reaches ~96–99% then triggers V8 mark-compact OOM and node exits. Supervisor autorestarts, cycle repeats. serve-production.js on :3000 proxies to :3001 but fails ready-check, so Cloudflare returns 502/504. Mitigation: raise --max-old-space-size to 4096+ for the expo program, or produce a proper SPA static export (dist/client/index.html + hashed JS) so the production proxy serves static bytes without invoking Metro.
